items.post: Dopamine 3 compatibility is split by device category: arm64e covers iOS 15.0–17.3.1, A12/A13 cover iOS 15.0–18.7.1 plus a separate iOS 26.0–26.0.1 range, and arm64 covers iOS 15.0–18.7.1. Check the exact category and iOS https://nextsolution.cc/dopamine-3-jailbreak.html
